text:
kevin: FYI HalcyonBank's dedicated pool (eu-west-1) — we're seeing tail latency spikes during continuous batching when token_budget gets near 120k. p95 jumps intermittently.
maria: Do you have a recent profile? sounds like batching groups are growing too tall and causing kernel/regression interactions.
kevin: Attached quick postmortem + a run output from yesterday's 30m soak. main suspects: batch formation heuristic, KV cache prefetch eviction churn, and a kernel fallback path triggering under large batch sizes.
maria: Can you drop the config you're using? especially token_budget + queue limits.
kevin: ```
batching:
  mode: continuous
  token_budget: 120000
  queue_limit: 450
  batch_coalesce_ms: 8
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
kv_cache:
  prefetch: true
  eviction_window_ms: 250
  local_prefetch_threads: 2
``` 
kevin: Profile snippet (aggregated):
```
PROFILE: kernel=FusedAttn_v3 | avg_emit_ms=4.8 | p95_emit_ms=24.6 | avg_batch=6.9 | kv_hit_rate=0.58
REGRESSION: p95 +13% vs baseline when token_budget > 100000
TRACE: memcopy_count spike on kv_prefetch path
``` 
ayan: hmm kv_hit_rate down is concerning. When prefetch is enabled we sometimes do speculative KV copies that increase host->device memcopies and push some kernels into slower memory path.
maria: My initial thought — reduce token_budget to ~90k and tighten queue_limit to ~320, and lower batch_coalesce to 5ms. That will keep batches smaller so the newer fused kernels don't degrade.
sarah: Agreed. Also consider forcing kernel_selector to prefer the legacy tiled-attn for sequences > 1024 until we validate v3 heuristics. We should canary this config before full rollout.
kevin: How do we force kernel override? any CLI flag?
ayan: Use runtime override flag in the pool config or via redwoodctl:
```
redwoodctl pools update halcyonbank --set "runtime.kernel_override=legacy_tiled_attn:seq>1024"
redwoodctl debug trace --pool halcyonbank --duration 10m --filters=kernel,kvcache
```
maria: Also try disabling kv prefetch for the canary: prefetch=false and bump eviction_window_ms to 1000 to avoid churn.
sarah: I'll open a customer config request for a 48h canary with these params. Proposed canary config:
```
batching:
  token_budget: 95000
  queue_limit: 320
  batch_coalesce_ms: 5
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
kv_cache:
  prefetch: false
  eviction_window_ms: 1000
runtime:
  kernel_selector:
    override: "legacy_tiled_attn:seq>1024"
``` 
sre-bot: deploy.sre: Canary config change requested for pool=halcyonbank by sarah at 2026-03-17T14:22:00Z — ticket #DC-4891
kevin: I'll schedule the canary this afternoon and attach traces. will run the trace command and post p50/p95 and kernel breakdown after 30/120m.
maria: If we still see >10% p95 regression, next step is to capture a few end-to-end recordings with kv timers and do a microkernel flamegraph.
ayan: Also leave the continuous autoscale on but disable burst expansion for the canary to avoid cross-pool spill.
kevin: noted. thanks team — will update here with numbers. :thumbsup:
